fixes.explanation: Forgotten? Baker, that's a whole different word, and Balaam never says it. Verse 9 ends, “Blessed are those who bless you and cursed are those who curse you.” It's a matched set, like chocolate chips and a warm oven. Bless gets blessed, curse gets cursed, and there's no third option hiding in the dough.

Not quite, friend. Verse 25 says, “Then Balaam arose and returned to his homeland, and Balak also went on his way.” So both men head out, Balaam to his homeland and Balak on his own way. Balak's anger burned in verse 10 and Balaam gave his last oracles, so I bet that trip home was a quiet one.

problems.problem: The explanation is flat and repetitive. It restates the contrast without much of Papa Dorin's personality.
“After all that shouting” presents shouting as a fact, but the passage does not say anyone shouted.
